decision_scope: Technical visual acceptance of this exact exploratory asset set as a script-faithful production handoff. Preserve as exploratory references/control experiment; no canonical or production-ready approval.
useful_exploratory_work: Two full-color front/profile/back/expression proposals support design discussion. Costume and hair marks are readable and no spurious generated lettering is visible.
Two contact sheets provide visual prompts for all 15 S01 shot IDs, with S01-14 spread across two panels. This is nominal shot indexing, not complete action coverage.
Six separate parented bust parts and visibly changed arm positions across rendered frames demonstrate a functioning limited cutout control prototype.
Native PhotoCraft, EffectCraft, FilmCraft and DesignCraft projects exist and are structurally readable.
source_precedence: Current author corrections: 16:9/24 fps, stable real acting, no warped/sliding art presented as finished animation.
Current episode script and tasks/writing/S01_SHOOTING_SCRIPT.md control canoe assignments, shot action and timing.
research/supplied_references/approved_style_reference.png was directly viewed: textured dusk river image, useful finish reference, not identity approval or moonless lighting authority.
production/art_direction.json and canonical ART_DIRECTION.md / STYLE_BIBLE.md require individualized ink-drawn geometry. The original author pencil identity source remains unavailable.
tasks/writing/CHARACTER_DESIGN_BIBLE.md labels older Taíno build/costume descriptions subordinate. No historical authenticity certification is made.

limitations_and_defects.evidence: Boards S01-02/12/14 omit or fail to clearly stage Yara and wrapped cemí in lead; S01-08 co-locates girl and Dairon. Existing S01-02 frame includes unnamed adult survivors; those adults alone do not fail continuity.
limitations_and_defects.revision: Redraw Yara/bundle and girl/Dairon geography against current named cast and source visual staging. Keep unresolved spoken headcount question separate.

limitations_and_defects.issue: Missing pencil likeness authority and homogenized design
limitations_and_defects.evidence: Amaia and Dairon share very similar facial construction, tied curly hair and white/rust clothing. Dairon is extremely muscular, contrary to subordinate lean/hard proposal; Amaia is athletic rather than gaunt.
limitations_and_defects.revision: Obtain author identity reference/decision, then differentiate landmarks, mass and hair silhouettes; carry approved forms through sheets, boards and puppet.

limitations_and_defects.evidence: Amaia full-body front/profile have no pendant while all expression heads and puppet wear it. Board Dairon carries necklaces/arm ornaments missing from model sheet. White wrap drapes and skirt folds are not registered construction drawings.
limitations_and_defects.revision: Lock pendant, cord, arm ornaments, wrap route and seam/hem landmarks in a revised turnaround and apply consistently.

limitations_and_defects.issue: Visible assembly joints and restricted acting
limitations_and_defects.evidence: Assembled image and all three sampled frames show outlined oval shoulder/elbow caps and segmented arm seams. Forearms move but no replacement expression or substantive acting is demonstrated. Bust is truncated at waist.
limitations_and_defects.revision: Redraw overlapping joint flesh/cloth and clean mattes; verify extremes on contrasting backgrounds; add registered head/mouth/blink/hand and required full-body replacements before shot work.

limitations_and_defects.evidence: Boards are wide contact-sheet panels, not individual 16:9 scene layouts or exposure sets. Puppet comp is 1024x1024, 24 fps, two seconds, not an S01 shot. No legs, lips or blink controls.
limitations_and_defects.revision: Keep prototype labeled; produce shot-specific 1280x720/16:9 assets and exposures when approved; do not claim full scene animation from this test.

shot_coverage.observation: Paddle/water contact reads; entry, lift and expanding rings require additional drawings; BEFORE overlay absent from raw board.

Three hulls read, but lead lacks clearly identifiable Yara with wrapped cemí. Existing S01-02 source frame shows eleven survivors including unnamed adults, so adults in other canoes alone are not a defect.
Amaia and sleeping son read; empty seats and fading lost-person outlines are absent.
Arm, lightning and shell imagery represented; fevered children are reduced to an arm, shell becomes a literal luminous spiral object. Treat latter as interpretation, not locked prop.
Soldier/pole/bell staging visible; swinging bell close-up and independent clapper/contact are not supplied.
Three children and blue visible. Adult behind them agrees with existing source frame; detached vapor leaning bankward and bodily response still not established.
Seated writer keeps gaze on ledger. Two line actions and pen/page insert need drawings; rough seat geometry does not clearly establish the specified stump.
Girl is staged alongside Dairon in same hull; current script keeps girl in third canoe and Dairon in lead. Pointing substitutes for speaking to water; steering response requires separate coverage.
Root tunnel/bow, snapped wood and cloth are readable. Single pose cannot establish scrape-to-break-to-exit or reversed wind; paddle owner unresolved in script.
Boy listens toward offscreen bank; lips/performance and approved age-specific likeness missing.
Both palms contact drum. Beheto is muscular compared with subordinate frail/sunken proposal; adult behind him exists in source visual staging. No weight-transfer poses supplied.
Three canoes visible; missing/unclear Yara and bundle in lead. Foam turn and independent blade drag/lift not established.
Sleeping child against Amaia is readable with closed eyes; supporting arm/secure support should remain explicit in final crop and replacement poses.
Two panels give river roll and closed-book endpoint; inherits missing/unclear Yara and bundle, does not show clear passenger lean or last written line.
Black panel correct for visual endpoint; sound bridge not assessed.

functional_checks.method: Read-only archive/JSON structural inspection and direct sample-frame viewing; no native applications reopened by this reviewer.
functional_checks.photocraft: Five .pcraft archives exist, contain manifest/composite/tile content and pass ZIP CRC. This does not prove per-feature character separation.
functional_checks.effectcraft: amaia-puppet.ecproj parses; comp.json names head, torso, both upper arms and forearms, with head/arms parented to torso and forearms to upper arms. rig.json identifies 48 frames at 24 fps; 48 PNGs exist.
functional_checks.filmcraft: rig-preview.filmcraft parses with format/schema/project fields; MP4 exists. Full playback/audio not reviewed.
functional_checks.designcraft: production-book-v2/arthouse-art-book.designcraft passes ZIP CRC with document.json and image assets.

not_claimed: Canonical identity or exact historical costume
Finished shot animation, full motion review or sound quality
All scripted action drawn merely because all shot IDs have a representative panel
next_handoff: Return continuity/model/puppet revisions to coordinator. Preserve exact reviewed versions; revised versions require new review. Useful exploratory references may be shown with these limitations.
review_notes: Amended after directly viewing existing projects/cemi_episode_01/assets/keyframes/S01-02.png. It shows eleven occupants: four lead, three second, four third. Extra unnamed survivors alone are not a defect. Earlier inference that named cast exhausts survivors is withdrawn. Awaiting targeted v2 artwork for further review.
